gitCommit.body:
feat: real purgeCollection — owner-only whole-collection cascade purge + audit (#218)

* docs(spec): purgeCollection cascade design — total-erase, name-confirm, audit (purges follow-up)

* docs(spec): purgeCollection rev-2 — spec review folded (include-deleted resolve, non-vacuous tests, subquery counts)

* docs(plan): purgeCollection implementation plan (5 tasks, TDD)

* feat(repo): by-collection cascade deletes + Collection findByIdIncludingDeleted/hardDelete (purgeCollection)

Add 12 thin by-collection repo methods that later purgeCollection tasks
compose into a cascade purge. Each method lands in both the implementation
and its interface so strict-mode build agrees.

- Simple deletes (direct collection_id): SortResult, Session,
  CollectionPreferenceItem, Invitation, Membership
- Subquery-scoped deletes (via parent): SortResultShare + SortResultItem
  (via sort_results), DecisionEvent (via sessions)
- RETURNING/count/collection: Photo.hardDeleteByCollection (blob keys),
  Item.hardDeleteByCollection (count), Collection.findByIdIncludingDeleted
  (mirrors findById's mapToCollection) + Collection.hardDelete

Also fix two stale partial-mock casts in ScoringService.test.ts
(as unknown as I*Repository) re-surfaced by the widened DecisionEvent interface.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(collections): CollectionPurgeService — transactional cascade purge + audit + blobs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(api): real owner-only collection purge — include-deleted resolve + name confirm (purgeCollection)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(collections): un-mocked collection-purge cascade + atomicity + authz (purgeCollection)

Drives the real POST /api/collections/[id]/purge route -> CollectionPurgeService
-> real repos -> ephemeral Postgres. Mocks only auth, @vercel/blob del, and getDb.

Seeds a FULL collection (2nd member, 2 items, 2 http photos incl. soft-deleted,
session + decision_event, member preference, draft + finalized results with items,
a share, and an invitation) so every empty-after assertion is non-vacuous.

Cases: total cascade (all 10 child tables -> 0, collection hard-gone, one audit
row with matching metadata, del per http key); soft-delete -> purge resolution;
atomicity (hardDelete injection rolls the whole tx back, zero audit rows); and
authz/confirm precedence (403 member, 404 absent, 400 wrong confirm, 403 wins
over confirm for a non-owner).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: real collection purge — cascade + audit (purgeCollection); correct stale stub references

* chore(graphify): refresh
